Zapata Quantum has announced an early‑access “Quantum Pilot” designed to help enterprises discover, evaluate, and map potential quantum computing applications within their operations.  
The program supplies tools, resources, and expert guidance so businesses can assess the feasibility of integrating quantum solutions across key business areas.  
Coverage of the launch appeared on TradingView and was subsequently aggregated by global news providers such as Google News.
